Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 9-A #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat) and Tropical Storm CRISING
Issued at: 6:19 PM, 18 July 2025(Friday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Zambales.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Bataan, Bulacan, Rizal, Metro Manila, Cavite, Batangas, Pampanga and Tarlac.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija, Quezon and Laguna which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 PM today.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

data.raw_text:
Muling nagkasa ng joint operations ang MMDA Special Operations Group-Task Force for Road Clearing (SOG-TFRC) at Manila Traffic and Parking Bureau (MTPB) ngayong Biyernes, Hulyo 18.

Sinuyod nila kaninang umaga ang Velasquez Street at Vitas Street sa Maynila kung saan 22 ang naisyuhan ng mga citation tickets, habang pito ang nahatak na iba't ibang uri ng sasakyan.

Sunod na pinasadahan ng SOG-TFRC at MTPB ang tatlong kalsada na kinabibilangan ng Carlos Palanca, Casal, at Arlegui na pawang 8888 complaint areas. Umaabot sa 24 ang natiketan at 11 ang na-tow.

Maliban dito, nag-operate din ang SOG-TFRC sa Mabuhay Lanes sa Quezon City. Pito ang natiketan sa anti-illegal parking operations sa Scout Borromeo at Scout Esguerra, habang anim ang nahatak

#mmda
